title: The Porch Light Moon
skyStory: The full moon rises in Cancer tonight, ninety-nine percent bright and glowing over the snow like a porch light left on for everyone who has ever come home late. Cancer is the moon's own sign, so tonight the moon is at home in its slippers. It is sentimental. It is enormous. It would like to hear about your feelings, please, in full.

reading: The full moon in Cancer pulls on everything watery, including the parts of you that you usually keep under a lid. Somewhere around 8 pm, a feeling will float up that you have been too busy to feel. Let it come. Tigers are allowed to be soft. It is in the fine print.

The [[Nine of Cups]] in your shadow likes to say I will be happy when. Tonight the moon answers back: how about now. Look out the window at the snow, silver and blue. Name three things that are already good. Out loud, if you dare. The moon is a famously good listener.
joel.mission: Write one thing you are ready to let go of on a scrap of paper, and leave it on the windowsill under the full moon.
joel.omen: A ring around the moon tonight. It means something you let go of will come back as something better.

reading: Tonight the tide at the shore will run high and silver, and you will feel it in your chest before you see it. The moon is in a water sign, full and generous, and it wants to give you something: an evening with nothing to prove. Take it.

The [[Six of Swords]] is still rowing, but tonight the water is calm and bright enough to see the far shore. You are closer than you think. You do not need to row faster. Just look at how far the boat has come since the solstice. Tell someone one thing you have let go of this month. It counts.
nancy.mission: Stand by a window or the water tonight for three minutes, and name one weight you are setting down.
nancy.omen: Moonlight on snow so bright you can see your shadow. It means you are lighting the way for someone without knowing it.

together.text: Tonight, each of you writes one thing you are releasing, folds it small, and leaves it under the moon on a windowsill. Tomorrow the moon is fullest, so save your stones for that. Tonight is just for letting go, and the moon is happy to carry it away.

game.intro: The porch light moon is on, full and bright in Cancer. Saturn left it on for you. Now be beautifully wrong.
